entries.en: Added Claude Opus 5 (`claude-opus-5`), now the default Opus model — 1M context, fast mode at $10/$50 per Mtok
entries.zh: 添加了 Claude Opus 5 (`claude-opus-5`)，现在是默认 Opus 模型 — 1M 上下文，快速模式，每个 Mtok 10/50 美元

entries.en: Added `sandbox.network.strictAllowlist` setting to deny non-allowlisted hosts for sandboxed commands without prompting
entries.zh: 添加了`sandbox.network.strictAllowlist`设置，以拒绝非白名单主机执行沙盒命令而不提示

entries.en: Added `DirectoryAdded` hook that fires after `/add-dir` or the SDK `register_repo_root` control request registers a new working directory mid-session
entries.zh: 添加了`DirectoryAdded`挂钩，该挂钩在`/add-dir`或 SDK`register_repo_root`控制请求在会话中注册新工作目录后触发

entries.en: Added `mcp_server_errors` to the headless stream-json init event, listing `--mcp-config` entries skipped by config validation; terminal runs print a startup warning
entries.zh: 将 `mcp_server_errors` 添加到 headless stream-json init 事件中，列出配置验证跳过的 `--mcp-config` 条目；终端运行打印启动警告

entries.en: Added the `workflowSizeGuideline` settings key so the advisory Dynamic workflow size guideline can be set from any settings file; the `/config` row is hidden while one does
entries.zh: 添加了`workflowSizeGuideline`设置键，以便可以从任何设置文件设置咨询动态工作流程大小指南； `/config` 行被隐藏，而另一行则被隐藏

entries.en: Added nested subagent forwarding in stream-json: subagents spawned at depth-2+ now appear when `--forward-subagent-text` is set, keyed by their spawning Agent `tool_use` id
entries.zh: 在stream-json中添加了嵌套子代理转发：当设置`--forward-subagent-text`时，现在会出现在深度2+处生成的子代理，并通过其生成代理`tool_use`id进行键入

entries.en: Added HTTP status and error text to `claude mcp list` and `/mcp` when a server fails to connect, and a warning for MCP config values with hidden leading or trailing whitespace
entries.zh: 当服务器无法连接时，将 HTTP 状态和错误文本添加到`claude mcp list`和`/mcp`，并对带有隐藏前导或尾随空格的 MCP 配置值发出警告

entries.en: Added the current default workflow size to the running-workflow status line, with a pointer to `/config` for changing it
entries.zh: 将当前默认工作流程大小添加到正在运行的工作流程状态行，并使用指向`/config`的指针来更改它

entries.en: Improved the "Remote Control is only available via api.anthropic.com" error to name the specific setting that caused it
entries.zh: 改进「Remote Control 只能通过 api.anthropic.com 使用」报错：会指出导致该问题的具体设置

entries.en: Improved `claude --teleport` to show which repo your current checkout points at when it doesn't match the session's repo
entries.zh: 改进 `claude --teleport`：当前检出目录指向的仓库与会话所在仓库不一致时，会显示该仓库的信息

entries.en: Changed dynamic workflows to default to a medium size guideline (aim for fewer than 15 agents); pick another size or unrestricted with Dynamic workflow size in `/config`
entries.zh: 将动态工作流程更改为默认中等规模准则（目标是少于 15 个代理）；选择其他大小或不受`/config`中动态工作流程大小的限制

entries.en: Changed managed MCP allowlist/denylist `${VAR}` entries to resolve from the startup environment and managed-settings env instead of settings-file env
entries.zh: 更改了托管 MCP 允许列表/拒绝列表`${VAR}`条目，以从启动环境和托管设置环境（而不是设置文件环境）解析

entries.en: Changed the `/model` picker to highlight only the newest model's name, so the highlight marks the new release rather than an arbitrary subset of the list
entries.zh: 更改了`/model`选择器以仅突出显示最新型号的名称，因此突出显示标记新版本而不是列表的任意子集

entries.en: Updated the claude-api skill to default to Claude Opus 5, with a migration path from Opus 4.8
entries.zh: `claude-api` 技能默认改为 Claude Opus 5，并提供从 Opus 4.8 迁移的路径

entries.en: Subagents can now spawn nested subagents up to depth 3 by default (was 1); set CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_SUBAGENT_SPAWN_DEPTH=1 to disable nesting
entries.zh: 子代理现在默认可以嵌套生成子代理，深度最多为 3（原为 1）；设置 `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_SUBAGENT_SPAWN_DEPTH=1` 可关闭嵌套

entries.en: Fixed `claude -p` text output dropping the answer already produced when a turn dies on a mid-stream API error
entries.zh: 修复了`claude -p`文本输出，当回合因中流 API 错误而终止时，会丢弃已生成的答案

entries.en: Fixed the Fable model row showing "Requires usage credits" for plans that include it, when a stale cache had baked the label in
entries.zh: 修复当套餐包含 Fable 模型，但陈旧缓存留有旧标签时，Fable 模型行仍显示"需要使用额度"的问题

entries.en: Fixed the `/model` picker showing the merged Opus row as plain "Opus" instead of "Opus (1M context)"
entries.zh: 修复 `/model` 选择器中合并后的 Opus 行显示为"Opus"而非"Opus (1M context)"的问题

entries.en: Fixed copy-on-select inside GNU screen printing base64 into the terminal instead of copying the selection
entries.zh: 修复了 GNU 丝网打印 base64 内的选择复制到终端而不是复制选择的问题

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control clients keeping a stale fast-mode status after a model switch, reconnect, or failed org check
entries.zh: 修复了远程控制客户端在模型切换、重新连接或组织检查失败后保持过时的快速模式状态的问题

entries.en: Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_GIT_BASH_PATH` on Windows exiting or being used as bash when the path isn't a bash/sh binary; it's now ignored with a warning
entries.zh: 修复了 Windows 上的`CLAUDE_CODE_GIT_BASH_PATH`，当路径不是 bash/sh 二进制文件时退出或用作 bash；现在它被忽略并带有警告

entries.en: Fixed Vim mode: pressing ← on an empty prompt now returns to the agent view from NORMAL mode, not just INSERT
entries.zh: 修复了 Vim 模式：在空提示符下按 ← 现在可以从 NORMAL 模式返回到代理视图，而不仅仅是 INSERT

entries.en: Fixed screen-reader mode rewriting the entire input line on every keystroke instead of echoing only the typed character
entries.zh: 修复了屏幕阅读器模式在每次击键时重写整个输入行，而不是仅回显键入的字符

entries.en: Removed Opus 4.7 from fast mode; `/fast` now applies to Opus 5 and Opus 4.8
entries.zh: Opus 4.7 已从快速模式中移除；`/fast` 现在适用于 Opus 5 和 Opus 4.8
